name: 89131 · Las Vegas, NV
findings: ZIP 89131 (Las Vegas) has 109 nonprofit organizations. 43 of them (39%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 31 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (15% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 89131 (Las Vegas) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 89131 (Las Vegas) list membership on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 51% of the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 60 organizations here; 40% of all organizations here have no identified type.
